name: matchlock-extended-attributes-across-mounted-902a
instr:
matchlock cannot carry portable extended attributes for provenance, labels, capabilities, and build metadata across mounted filesystems. Implement guest-host attribute operations while preserving provider policy, routing, ownership, and filesystem behavior.

MemoryProvider, RealFSProvider, ReadonlyProvider, interceptProvider, and MountRouter must provide identical named-byte semantics. MountRouter routes each operation to the longest matching mount using its cleaned relative path and rejects cross-boundary and synthetic targets. Preserve validation, flag conflicts, value isolation, concurrency safety, and object-bound lifetime. RealFSProvider exposes native attributes without root escape. ReadonlyProvider forwards queries and rejects side-effect-free mutations.

Before routing, HookEngine sees each operation, mutable target, arguments, UID, GID, and single completion outcome. Framed CBOR preserves binary data, flags, names, required sizes, cancellation, and distinct errno outcomes. VFSServer dispatches recognized requests once and rejects unknown operations without provider access. Guest getxattr, setxattr, listxattr, and removexattr callbacks follow Linux zero-size and undersized-buffer behavior without partial results.

ErrXattrNotFound is exactly "extended attribute not found" and ErrXattrExists is exactly "extended attribute exists". HookOpGetXattr, HookOpSetXattr, HookOpListXattr, and HookOpRemoveXattr have values "getxattr", "setxattr", "listxattr", and "removexattr" re
